rules.readers: prototype Reader, Writer, reactor, and diagnostic snapshots
rules.published_or_protected_data: prototype generation tokens, queue cells, pins, shutdown state, and telemetry
rules.required_happens_before: release publication/ownership transfer is acquired by the consuming lane; seq_cst reader turns close prototype reclamation cycles
rules.invariant: prototype slots are not reused while pinned and no consumer observes a partially initialized generation or queue cell
rules.relaxed_justification: relaxed operations are single-owner state or observational telemetry; generation, queue, pin, and shutdown authority use the acquire/release operations in the same domain

rules.readers: instrumented production paths in fault-enabled builds
rules.published_or_protected_data: armed fault site and remaining-count state
rules.required_happens_before: site release publishes an initialized remaining count; consumers acquire the site before decrementing it
rules.invariant: a configured Nth failure fires once and a cleared slot cannot consume a stale count
rules.relaxed_justification: RNG state and remaining counters are atomic values with no non-atomic payload; site release/acquire carries configuration authority

rules.published_or_protected_data: independent counters and enable flag only
rules.invariant: telemetry never publishes or gates Store authority
rules.relaxed_justification: every value is diagnostic and approximate; no object lifetime or correctness state depends on it

rules.readers: routing-state consumers and default hash helpers
rules.required_happens_before: one seq_cst order places odd revision, both payload stores, and even revision; readers validate both payload loads between equal even revisions
rules.invariant: a reader returns one complete routing revision and never a torn algorithm/seed pair
rules.relaxed_justification: only the writer-lock wait path is relaxed; the coherent revision and payload values participate in the seq_cst publication order

rules.required_happens_before: process/thread startup sequencing; no associated non-atomic payload
rules.invariant: each Index captures one atomic seed value
rules.relaxed_justification: the atomic is the complete value and is configured before worker publication; it does not publish other memory

rules.published_or_protected_data: bounded queue cells and producer/consumer positions
rules.required_happens_before: cell/position release publishes initialized payload; acquire grants the consumer or next producer ownership
rules.invariant: a cell has one owner and is never overwritten before release
rules.relaxed_justification: position hints and same-owner cursor updates do not publish payload; per-cell release/acquire is the ownership edge

rules.published_or_protected_data: connection handoff cells, pending counts, and admission state
rules.required_happens_before: queue release/acquire transfers socket ownership; admission acq_rel closes and drains submissions
rules.invariant: a socket belongs to at most one reactor/poller and accepted handoffs are drained or rejected
rules.relaxed_justification: counts are telemetry/admission bookkeeping after ownership is established by queue and admission edges

rules.writer: reactor, disk-reader lanes, and server shutdown controller
rules.readers: reactor completions, disk workers, join/drain observers, and health probes
rules.published_or_protected_data: connection cancellation epochs, bounded I/O tasks, admission counts, stop state, and health
rules.required_happens_before: release publishes cancellation/stop/task state; acquire consumers stop, cancel, drain, or adopt the corresponding payload
rules.invariant: no stale completion revives a closed connection and no background owner survives terminal drain
rules.relaxed_justification: connection/activity counters and owner-private outstanding counts are observational; cancellation, queue, admission, and stop edges use acquire/release

rules.published_or_protected_data: independent counters and atomic rate-state values
rules.required_happens_before: none beyond atomicity; policy decisions use the value returned by their own RMW
rules.invariant: counters never publish object lifetime or Store authority
rules.relaxed_justification: the atomics are self-contained counters/token arithmetic; the returned RMW value, not ordering of other memory, decides admission

rules.writer: client close/reconfiguration and in-flight operation guards
rules.readers: client request threads and drain waiters
rules.published_or_protected_data: client lifecycle, active-operation count, and routing revision
rules.required_happens_before: close/reconfiguration release is acquired before admission or retry; acq_rel counters delimit drain
rules.invariant: close waits for admitted operations and a request never uses a superseded routing state
rules.relaxed_justification: local attempt counters/observations do not publish payload; lifecycle and revision transitions use acquire/release

rules.writer: filesystem failure paths, appenders, and backup workers
rules.readers: Store admission, segment operations, and backup coordinator
rules.published_or_protected_data: fail-closed directory/segment health, append ownership, and bounded backup work
rules.required_happens_before: release health failure is acquired before later I/O; queue/worker releases publish completed backup state
rules.invariant: I/O never proceeds through authority known unhealthy and backup tasks retain their source authority until joined
rules.relaxed_justification: progress and byte counters are telemetry or mutex-owned; health/admission/worker completion use acquire/release

rules.readers: Store operations, maintenance, backup, and diagnostic snapshots
rules.published_or_protected_data: catalog health, operation admission/drain, maintenance state, commit and rotation progress
rules.required_happens_before: admission/health release is acquired before authority use; mutex/CV domains protect Manifest and Index payload
rules.invariant: no operation enters after close/fail-closed and Manifest authority is observed only under its mutex/catalog generation contract
rules.relaxed_justification: attempt/result/latency counters and mutex-owned progress do not publish durable authority; admission and health atomics carry correctness

rules.published_or_protected_data: Worker close/health state and operation counts
rules.required_happens_before: close release is acquired by admission/drain observers
rules.invariant: no mutation runs after Worker close and admitted operations drain before destruction
rules.relaxed_justification: metrics and owner-private counters are observational; lifecycle/admission transitions use acquire/release

rules.writer: Store operations, close, and maintenance scheduler
rules.readers: operation admission, close drain, and maintenance observers
rules.published_or_protected_data: Store lifecycle, active-operation counts, background-worker state, and maintenance observations
rules.required_happens_before: close/health release is acquired before admission and destruction; operation finish acq_rel wakes drain
rules.invariant: no new Store operation enters after the close LP and background maintenance is joined before resources are released
rules.relaxed_justification: scheduler selection and metrics are approximate/self-contained; lifecycle and drain atomics provide the required edges

rules.writer: one shard Writer/execution-token owner plus Reader lease/admission participants
rules.readers: paired Readers, Writer reclaim, submitters, shutdown, and stats snapshots
rules.published_or_protected_data: immutable generations, slot tokens, mutation/completion cells, leases, merge state, fail-closed and shutdown state
rules.required_happens_before: release generation/queue/stop publication pairs with acquire adoption/consumption; lease fence and acq_rel drop close reclamation; execution token acq_rel serializes shard mutation
rules.invariant: one mutator owns a shard; Readers see complete immutable generations; pins/leases outlive borrows; reclaim precedes reuse only after a safe epoch
rules.relaxed_justification: relaxed fields are Writer-owned state, sequence-protected memory census, or telemetry; the token, queue, publication, lease, health, and shutdown atomics carry synchronization
